scientific_reading: QP092A moves past the Higgs audit. Using the current CR062a/QP075 particle ledger, it treats each non-Higgs predicted mass as the native route weight and emits the signed post-route surface debit needed to reach the observed/reveal mass. The scan confirms the two-stage grammar for non-Higgs rows under the existing zero-free-parameter ledger: native route first, observed surface second. It does not yet derive a closed native law for every Pi_surface_debit; that debit operator remains the next discovery layer.
